title: "Data & Measurement"

A large share of my work is building the instruments other researchers use.
This page describes what those are and where to find them.

## Informal Sector Enterprise Survey (IS-WBES)

I coordinate the Unit's informal sector survey work across 15 countries,
overseeing the task team leaders who implement it. That included developing the
collection methodology and the implementation infrastructure behind it —
measuring businesses that do not appear in any sampling frame is a hard problem,
and the adaptive cluster sampling approach we settled on is documented in
[Aga et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1093/jssam/smac037).

[Informal business data at Enterprise Surveys](https://www.enterprisesurveys.org)

## World Bank Enterprise Surveys (WBES)

I have served as Task Team Leader for Enterprise Survey implementation in the
United States, Canada, and Israel (2024–25); West Bank and Gaza (2023);
Malaysia (2020–21); 11 European Union countries (2019); 31 economies in Latin
America and the Caribbean (2010 and 2017); and 7 MENA economies (2013, 2014,
and 2023). The role covers contractor management, data collection and quality
control, and working with national statistics offices on sampling frames and
business population projections.

[enterprisesurveys.org](https://www.enterprisesurveys.org)

## Business Ready (B-READY)

I act as the DECEA coordinator to the B-READY project, developing and
consolidating consultations on the firm-level questions integrated into the
report. The first round drew on Enterprise Survey data from approximately 55
economies; I currently lead question refinement for the second round of
collection.

[Business Ready](https://www.worldbank.org/en/businessready)

## Policy Indicator Briefs

Series coordinator and co-editor, with Norman Loayza, of the Indicator Group's
Policy Indicator Briefs — providing analytical guidance through editing and
production. Over 50 briefs published to date.
